name: Citation
usage: Numbered citations in AI answers, footnote-style references in generated text

props.name: index
props.description: The number shown, usually the position of the source in Sources (starting at 1).

types.name: SourceItem
types.summary: One source of Sources and Citation.

fields.name: key
fields.description: Stable key; the index is used when omitted.

fields.name: title
fields.description: Title of the page or document.

fields.name: url
fields.description:
Address. Only http, https, mailto and relative addresses become links (others are shown as text); the site
name is taken from it.

fields.name: icon
fields.description:
An icon for the site, provided by the application (such as an image from its own server). Remote site icons
are never loaded automatically.

examples.name: Basic
examples.title: Basic usage
examples.description:
Place a Citation after the sentence it supports. Hover it or focus it with `Tab` to see the source; the number
links to it.

examples.name: InMarkdown
examples.title: In Markdown
examples.description:
Give Markdown the `sources` and it renders `[1]`, `[2]` in the reply as citations; put the list under the reply
with Sources.
